tasks.pairing: same seed, same tier, same embodiment, teleport reset, oracle verifier

equivalence.rule: absolute difference of paired success rates

exclusions: infrastructure_invalid (confinement or launcher failure) with one retry of the same seed
acceptance.retry_rule: one retry of the same seed after an infrastructure-invalid record; the invalid run stays in the record

commands.typed: uv run harness rollout --graph graphs/pilot_t1_l2_typed.yaml --tier T1 --episodes 8 --seeds 0..7
commands.monolithic: uv run harness monolith run --module experts/monolithic/pilot_t1_l2.py --tier T1 --episodes 8 --seeds 0..7 --task-surface t1-l2-pilot-v1
commands.gate: uv run harness monolith parity --typed <typed>/episodes.jsonl --monolithic <mono>/episodes.jsonl --task-surface t1-l2-pilot-v1

acceptance.note: Proposed L2 candidate engineering parity protocol, inherited acceptance thresholds unchanged. Independent authorship and separate operator remain absent; this protocol cannot pass those gates. These public engineering seeds and records are NOT the six-session-per-arm pilot registration and cannot be pooled with it. No feasibility or parity outcome is asserted.

stopping_rule: all listed seeds run once per arm; no post-result additions
